# langsmith_org_chart (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith organization-scoped custom chart by ID. Note: the LangSmith single-chart read endpoint does not return `section_id`; if you need to reference a chart's section, manage it via the `langsmith_org_chart` resource instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_org_chart" "example" {
  id = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the org chart.

### Read-Only

- `chart_type` (String) The chart type (`line` or `bar`).
- `common_filters` (String) JSON-encoded common filter configuration.
- `description` (String) A description of the chart.
- `index` (Number) The display order index.
- `metadata` (String) JSON-encoded metadata object.
- `series` (String) JSON-encoded array of chart series configurations.
- `title` (String) The title of the chart.
